The green flash is a brief optical phenomenon near sunrise or sunset, usually seen as green light at the upper edge of the Sun when atmospheric refraction, scattering, mirage conditions, and a clear distant horizon align. Its science is real, but its patience-based viewing gives it the shape of a horizon legend.
